test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

Solving the riddle given by our teacher is __farther__ beyond our capacity.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. far .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The expression "far beyond" means something that is much more than or beyond a certain point.
 
• "Farther" and "farthest" are used to compare physical distances, whereas "far" is suited for non-physical distances or capacities.
 
• In this context, to describe the capacity, "far" is the appropriate choice.

Correct sentence: *Solving the riddle given by our teacher is far beyond our capacity*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Far:**

 
 
• **Usage:** It is used to indicate a great distance in a non-physical sense (e.g. ability, capacity).
 
• **Example:** This problem is far beyond my understanding.
 
 
 
• **Farther:**
 
 
• **Usage:** It is primarily used to compare physical distances.
 
• **Example:** This library is farther from my home than the school.
 
 
 
• **Farthest:**
 
 
• **Usage: ** It is used to indicate the greatest physical distance.
 
• **Example: ** Pluto is the farthest planet from the sun in our solar system.
